fields.statement: Verifier at de45583d. Read the diff: stepRunner's Leaves, LeafAnswer, Answer and Evidence (the calls the leaves and checks steps and their arbiter waits make) now go through readModel (internal/api/run_model_cache.go), which keeps the worktree's index open, refreshes it by a stat fingerprint (Index.Refresh/Stamp) and keeps answers while the stamp, or the per-change-set Signature, is unchanged. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v -run TestDriverPollIsCheap ./internal/api/ (PASS; also PASS under -race): on a gen'd log of 120 landed + 6 in-flight change sets with IndexPath set and a live session record, 5 idle polls show ctx.readLog 0, catch-up Read/Decoded/Folded 0 and no answer recomputed; after an entry in an unrelated change set the next poll reads the log 0 times and folds exactly 1 change set; after an entry in the run's change set the leaves go 2->3, and a session done mark is seen (SaidDone). Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v -run TestReadBudget ./internal/api/ (PASS, quiettest, medians): driver poll idle median 4.06ms CPU (budget 5ms), after an unrelated entry 5.51ms (budget 50ms); a second run (whole package, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api/, ok) gave 2.24ms and 6.33ms. go test -trimpath ./internal/index/... ok, incl. TestSignature.
